RAJYA SABHA
—————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 16, 2003/Agrahayana 25, 1925 (Saka)
—————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and
Culture; Water Resources)
Total  number  of  questions—20
62
Debt swap scheme for States
*201.  DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
   SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether States have pre-paid
Rs. 23,000 crore of high cost debts in the
first seven months ending October 31, 2003
in the current financial year taking
advantage of the debt-swap scheme;
(b) if so, whether this pre-payment will
also help States in decreasing funds and
improving State finances; and
(c) if so, to what extent States have pre-
paid their debts uptil now?
Management of Kolkata Stock
Exchange
*202. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY : Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have noticed
deficiencies in the management of Kolkata
Stock Exchange;
(b) if so, the steps being taken to
streamline the working of the Exchange;
and
(c) what steps SEBI is taking to ensure
normal working of stock Exchanges?
Recommendation of working group
*203. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
examined the recommendations made by
working group on Petroleum and Natural
Gas submitted last year;
(b) if so, the details thereof, particularly
the recommendations made for
incorporation in the Tenth Five Year Plan;
and
(c) the action taken by Government
thereon?
Supply of under-weight cylinders
†*204. DR. AKHTAR HASAN
RIZVI: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
gas cylinders being supplied to the
consumers contain less gas than the
prescribed weight;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

Reduced rate of interest on housing
loans
†*205. SHRIMATI  KAMLA
MANHAR:
SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of rates of interest being
realised by the banks and the public
institution on housing loans as per the
policy of Government;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Amro
Bank has reduced the same to 6 per cent;
(c) if so, whether the banks under the
control of Government also propose to
make reduction in their rates; and
(d) the arrangement likely to be made
by the Government for the said purpose?
Inclusion of Majuli Island as National
Heritage site
*206. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state the
implementation status of the proposal to
include Majuli Island of Assam for funding
under NCF and Oil Foundation as a
National Heritage site by amendment of
existing norms for considering cases under
cultural landscape category in addition to
monuments as recommended by
Government of Assam?
Retail outlets of ONGC
*207. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether ONGC has been granted
permission to set up about 500 retail outlets
in the country;
(b) if so, the break up of the outlets
proposed to be set up in various States of
the country, State-wise; and
(c) by when, these are going to become
operational?
Adulteration in Petrol
†*208. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that despite its all out efforts
adulteration in petrol could not be checked
and a large number of complaints of car-
engines getting out of order due to
adulterated petrol are being received from
the consumers;
(b) if so, whether Government have
worked out any scheme to initiate stringent
action against persons indulging in the
adulteration of petrol; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Scheme for filing Income Tax returns
*209. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
reviewed the operation of the recently
introduced limited scheme for filing
Income Tax returns electronically, by

RAJYA SABHA
—————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 16, 2003/Agrahayana 25, 1925 (Saka)
—————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism
and Culture; Water Resources)
Total  number  of  questions — 155
304
Hassle-free air travel
1388. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
take steps to ensure hassle-free and more
pleasant air travel;
(b) if so, the details of this customer-
friendly project; and
(c) the initiatives of the aviation
industry to control losses and regain its lost
prominence?
Facilities at Dabolim Airport
1389. SHRI EDUARDO FALEIRO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) what slots are currently available
for civilian flights landing and taking off
from Dabolim Airport and out of these,
which slots are available throughout the
week;
(b) the number of passengers landing
and taking off each year from Dabolim
during the last three years;
(c) whether the airport facilities at
Dabolim are considered adequate for
current and potential enhanced load of
passengers and cargo; and
(d) whether Government are
considering the possibility of permitting
international flights (other than charter
flights) to land at the Dabolim Airport?
Designated air routes
for helicopters
1390. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulated to chart out
designated air routes for helicopters,
particularly during their take off and
landing, so as to eliminate their queue up
at airports and/or mid air hovering on the
taxiway; and
(b) if so, the details thereof with its
present status?

305
F:\WIN2\NSESSION/3862RS.PM5 305
Delay in privatisation of civil aviation
sector
1391. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that process of
privatisation in civil aviation sector has
been delayed;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) if not, the progress made in this
regard;
(d) whether any specific time-frame
has been fixed for the completion of
process; and
(e) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the measures taken in this regard?
Permission for foreign tourist charter
flights
1392. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
allow foreign tourist charter flights on
almost all the major airports;
(b) if so, what are the details in this
regard; and
(c) what other steps are in the pipeline
to attract more foreign tourists?
Bangalore International Airport
Project
1393. SHRI M.V. RAJA-
SEKHARAN:
SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the stage of progress on international
airport at Devanahalli, Bangalore;
(b) by when the actual work of the
airport will start;
(c) what is the original estimated cost
of the airport project; and
(d) what is the present estimated cost
of the project?
Purchase of smaller aircrafts by AI
1394. SHRI A. VIJAYA-
RAGHAVAN: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India decided to buy
smaller aircrafts, especially 146 seater, a
class of aircraft in tune with Indian
Airlines requirements;
(b) if so, the details including number
and the total amount proposed to spent for
the purchase;
(c) whether the decision to buy smaller
aircrafts will result in the competition with
Indian Airlines in the light of the "open
sky policy"; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Development of Kolkata as a regional
hub
1395. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 1 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 2nd December, 2003 and state:
(a) whether Government and its
national carriers (Air India and Indian
Airlines) are gearing up to take advantage
of the opportunities emanating from open
sky policy with countries of ASEAN;
(b) if so, whether Kolkata Airport is
sought to be developed as a regional hub
in this context;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

Expansion of Indian Airlines Airport
Services Ltd.
1396. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have approved fresh investment and
expansion of Indian Airlines Airport
Services Ltd., a subsidiary of Indian
Airlines; and
(b) if so, the purpose for investment
and whether the said business plan has
been approved by the Board of Indian
Airlines?

 Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to  state:
(a) whether any modernization plans
have been envisaged to make airports
world class in view of the unsatisfactory
state of affairs in the management of the
airports
